## Books
Reading has been a long standing hobby of mine, and it's something I try to do as often as I can because life can get in the way {{< iconify emojione anxious-face-with-sweat >}} I've made a list of some books I've really enjoyed reading, please take some inspiration to find your next read!

__Currently reading:__ The City and Its Uncertain Walls by Haruki Murakami

__Reads I've enjoyed:__

| Title | Author | Star Rating | One-line review |
|-------|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| Project Hail Mary | Andy Weir | {{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa regular star >}} | This book scratches a good itch in my science brain. |
| Crying in H Mart | Michelle Zauner | {{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa regular star >}} | Food is for sure a love language!! |
| 1984 | George Orwell | {{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}} | Winston’s character development was seamless, beautifully done by Big Brother. |
| Girl, Woman, Other | Bernadine Evaristo | {{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}} | It was an out of body experience. |
| Circe | Madeline Miller | {{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa star >}}{{< fa regular star >}} | Madeline Miller eats again. |

## Making sourdough
I've had my starter Stewie Jr., a descendant of my friend's starter Stewie, since 2025. Since then, I've been making bread for myself, friends, and family! I truly cannot remember the last time I bought a loaf of bread from the store.

Currently, I've just been making bread. Stay tuned for my pizza journey!

## Playing Ultimate Frisbee
I was introduced to Ultimate in high school, where one of my coaches suggested I play in college. I took his advice, and being on the UCSD B-Co gave me the best four years I could've asked for!

I was honored to be captain for the last two years on the team, enhancing my communication skills between the school, my team, and coaches.
